decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin aligns with current analytics needs and the firm's core services, so management will likely persist despite any early difficulties.
Universal Analytics has been discontinued, making the plugin's results permanently poor, and with only a brief website mention there is little commitment to justify keeping it.

The retail system interface plugin has only a brief mention, but its results can still be seen as temporary and it supports the firm's integration services, so management is moderately likely to keep it.
The SEO support service is presented on its own page, signaling strong public commitment and a central service, so management will likely keep it.
